about_the_game:
It is said that there is a divine dragon in the west, and if you get it, you can live forever and be invincible! Countless people have joined the chase, the weak die a violent death, and the winner takes all. Will you be the one who goes the furthest? ...... A joyful card self-propelled game. You can choose equipment and magic treasures, cultivate fruit trees and demonic beasts, and form a squad to kill the four directions and bravely travel west! You can choose a variety of characters to start the game, you can also participate in asynchronous matching ranked mode and other players caught against each other, the genre is super, each game is a new experience!



The game innovatively integrates the farming element into the self-propelled chess mode, and packages the gameplay with the logic of planting trees, brewing wine, eating and trading. Plant trees to get stronger! Raise pigs to get stronger! Foster genres and your “farming” program is inseparable, super immersive and very grounded!



30+ Characters, 100+ Card Items, but with only 12 squares in total, you'll need to fire your brain like crazy to find the best placement of items. Then you need to perfectly match your character's position and explore the optimal solution for your skill set. Constructed enthusiasts are ecstatic!



The drawing style is abstract, but it's casual and decompressing and only so very good!



Based on personal preferences chose the worldview of Chinese mythology, stewing various mythological characters and ancient occupations, Yan Luo Mengma, Zhu Yao Taotie, Taoist priests and shopkeepers are on the same stage, and Jubilee Pots, Wealthy Economy, Banana Fans, and Kongming Bowls are all here to help.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 (SP1+) and above
  • Processor: x64 or x86
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1000 MB available space

short_description: This is a fun auto battler game. Choose and equip magic weapons, cultivate amazing plant and monsters. Build your team to dominate the west!
supported_languages: English, Simplified Chinese, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Russian, Japanese, Traditional Chinese, Portuguese - Brazil, Portuguese - Portugal, Spanish - Latin America, Korean
